title: US Appeals Court Backs Fed’s Decision to Deny Custodia Bank a Master Account
summary: A federal appeals court in Denver has upheld the Federal Reserve’s right to deny crypto-focused bank Custodia access to a master account. The post US Appeals Court Backs Fed’s Decision to Deny Custodia Bank a Master Account appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: Charting the Global Economy: Fed Reins in Rate-Cut Expectations
summary: Central bankers in North America’s two largest economies lowered borrowing costs this week, though yields on government debt climbed after the heads of US Federal Reserve and the Bank of Canada damped expectations for further reductions by year-end.
